paraphrase: Zero tolerance for anything that endangers children: no content or use that facilitates abuse, grooming, sexualisation, sextortion or trafficking; no adult themes, excessive violence, dangerous acts or negative body-image content in an app that appeals to children. Anonymous chat, random chat, social and dating apps must publish standards prohibiting child abuse, offer in-app reporting, remove such material on knowledge, comply with child-safety law including reporting to the relevant authority, and name a child-safety contact.
